cases.sentence: В Петербурге, еще до получения известия об оставлении Москвы, был составлен ___ всей войны и прислан Кутузову для руководства.
cases.explain: «подробный план» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The Russian army was commanded by Kutúzov and his staff, and also by the Emperor from Petersburg. Before the news of the abandonment of Moscow had been received in Petersburg, a detailed plan of the whole campaign had been drawn up and sent to Kutúzov for his guidance. Though this plan had been drawn up on the supposition that Moscow was still in our hands, it was approved by the staff and accepted as a basis for action. Kutúzov only replied that movements arranged from a distance were always difficult to execute. So fresh instructions were sent for the solution of difficulties that might be encountered, as well as fresh people who were to watch Kutúzov’s actions and report upon them.

cases.sentence: Кутузов писал только, что ___ всегда трудно исполнимы.
cases.explain: «дальние диверсии» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: И, для разрешения встречавшихся трудностей, присылались ___ и лица, долженствовавшие следить за его действиями и доносить о них.
cases.explain: «новые наставления» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.

cases.sentence: Кроме того, теперь в ___ преобразовался весь штаб.
cases.explain: «русской армии» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Besides this, the whole staff of the Russian army was now reorganized. The posts left vacant by Bagratión, who had been killed, and by Barclay, who had gone away in dudgeon, had to be filled. Very serious consideration was given to the question whether it would be better to put A in B’s place and B in D’s, or on the contrary to put D in A’s place, and so on—as if anything more than A’s or B’s satisfaction depended on this.

cases.sentence: — писал государь от 2-го октября, в письме, полученном после ___.
cases.explain: «Тарутинского сражения» — after the preposition «после», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.

cases.sentence: По рапортам от генерала Винцингероде вижу я, что неприятельский 10 000-й корпус подвигается к ___.
cases.explain: «Петербургской дороге» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
«Владимирской дороге» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.

cases.sentence: Но в то время как письмо это, доказывающее то, что ___ сил уже отражалось и в Петербурге, было в дороге, Кутузов не мог уже удержать командуемую им армию от наступления, и сражение уже было дано.
cases.explain: «существенное отношение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But by the time this letter, which proved that the real relation of the forces had already made itself felt in Petersburg, was dispatched, Kutúzov had found himself unable any longer to restrain the army he commanded from attacking and a battle had taken place.

cases.sentence: 2-го октября казак Шаповалов, находясь в разъезде, убил из ружья одного и подстрелил ___.
cases.explain: «другого зайца» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the second of October a Cossack, Shapoválov, who was out scouting, killed one hare and wounded another. Following the wounded hare he made his way far into the forest and came upon the left flank of Murat’s army, encamped there without any precautions. The Cossack laughingly told his comrades how he had almost fallen into the hands of the French. A cornet, hearing the story, informed his commander.

cases.sentence: Гоняясь за подстреленным зайцем, Шаповалов забрел далеко в лес и наткнулся на ___ армии Мюрата, стоящий без всяких предосторожностей.
cases.explain: «левый фланг» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
